# InComm and Atleos bring cardless cash to 23,000 ATMs

InComm and Atleos bring cardless cash to 23,000 ATMs")
InComm and Atleos bring cardless cash to 23,000 ATMs")

InComm Payments has joined forces with NCR Atleos to deliver cardless cash pickup services at more than 23,000 ATMs across the United States, aiming to widen self-service financial access for consumers and financial institutions.

The move sees InComm Payments adopting Atleos’ ReadyCode API, which is designed to allow FinTech and banking partners to offer cardless withdrawals using a simple, secure code sent directly through the apps customers already trust.

## Simplify your cash transactions

Welcome to ReadyCode, where we redefine how you access and manage cash. Our innovative cardless solutions offer a secure, convenient and efficient way to send and receive cash payments without the need for physical cards.

ReadyCode is a card-free, API-based transaction platform that opens up a world of possibilities. It’s designed to support a wide range of use cases—from digital wallets and peer-to-peer (P2P) payments to gaming, bill payments and even crypto payment transactions.

What makes ReadyCode unique is its ability to bypass traditional payment rails, enabling access to millions of account types that were previously out of reach. This is about expanding financial access and simplifying the user experience.

## Cardless cash: A world of opportunity

Since the early days of self-service banking, a plastic card has been the only way to access funds at the ATM. Not any more. ReadyCode disconnects the card from digital account access, enabling consumers to access cash and receive cash payments from virtually any digital account (bank account or otherwise) with a simple numeric code at tens of thousands of ATMs.

Through our API, your app, call center or online banking platform can issue a ReadyCode cash code that enable easy cash access in well-known retail locations. And what’s more, that same API can enable cash to be loaded into accounts at thousands of appropriately equipped devices.

results.title: InComm Partners with NCR Atleos on Cardless Cash ATMs - Finovate
results.content: InComm Payments has adopted Atleos’ ReadyCode API which will enable InComm Payments’ fintech and banking partners to offer cardless cash pickup at more than 23,000 ATMs around the country. The partnership offers a scaled ATM network and API solution in ReadyCode that will help InComm Payments bridge the “digital-to-physical” cash payments gap and allow consumers to make cardless cash withdrawals via a simple and secure code delivered through their preferred application. ReadyCode is currently enabled in ATMs in retail locations in more than 40 states in the US. [...] “Atleos’ ReadyCode API offering provides an additional modality and channel for our money movement partners and their consumers to access cash in a self-service manner at ATMs located at some of the nation’s most convenient retailers,” InComm Payments VP of Product John Houseal said. “This service expands our cash-out network in a new way, connecting our partners with differentiated access to serve their customers beyond the counter.” [...] “Enabling InComm Payments’ broad and deep program relationships with access to the ReadyCode solution will provide more flexibility for consumers to transact where and how they want, without the need for a card,” Atleos SVP, Global Network Solutions, Ben Bregman said. “This relationship will also provide additional use cases to drive utilization of the ATM for increasingly digital-first providers beyond traditional financial institutions, and continue to fulfill on our promise to our retail partners to drive incremental foot traffic to their stores.”
